name: HP
look: Pure white with alternating fog bands, one electric blue appearing at most twice per viewport, and blue chevrons framing the hero.

hero.title: Work that keeps up
hero.sub: A fourteen-inch aluminium laptop with a fifteen-hour battery, a repairable design, and a keyboard somebody clearly tested for a full working day.

features.title: Made to be kept
features.sub: Repairability, parts availability and a battery that lasts the day — the things that decide whether a laptop is still in use in year four.

items.title: Fifteen-hour battery
items.body: Measured on real mixed use, not a video loop with the screen at minimum brightness.

items.title: Repairable
items.body: Standard screws, a replaceable battery, and service manuals published free.

items.title: Five years of parts
items.body: Committed parts availability, so a repair in year four is possible rather than theoretical.

items.title: A keyboard for typing
items.body: 1.5mm travel and a layout that survives a full working day without adaptation.

items.title: Recycled materials
items.body: Ninety percent recycled aluminium in the chassis, with the recycled content stated per component.

items.title: Business ready
items.body: Firmware protection, remote management and a three-year on-site warranty option.

showcases.title: Ink you can buy from anyone
showcases.body: Cartridges are not region-locked, third-party ink does not disable the printer, and firmware updates never remove a feature you paid for. That policy is written down.

showcases.title: Managed without being locked
showcases.body: Fleet management, firmware policy and remote wipe for organisations, without preventing an individual machine from being repaired or resold at end of life.

gallery.title: SUPPORT
gallery.sub: Manuals, drivers, parts and repair guides.

testimonial.quote: I replaced the battery myself in eleven minutes with a manual they published for free. That is why we are buying forty more.
testimonial.name: Peter Nowak

pricing.title: SHOP
pricing.sub: Three configurations, with free next-day delivery.

tiers.desc: More memory and a brighter panel.

items.q: How long will parts be available?
items.a: Five years from the end of sale, committed in writing rather than offered as a best effort.
Yes. Cartridges are not region-locked and third-party ink does not disable the printer. That policy is published and we do not change it by firmware update.

items.q: What is the real battery life?
items.a: Fifteen hours on mixed use at 150 nits — office work, browsing and video calls. The test methodology is published alongside the figure.

cta.title: Built to be kept
cta.sub: Five years of parts, free service manuals, and a battery you can replace.

notes: Pure white with deep ink running every body surface; light fog bands alternate to set the section rhythm.
The electric blue is the lone CTA fill and link colour, and it appears at most twice per viewport.
One bespoke face covers display, body, button and caption at four weights.
Cards round at 16px while buttons stay tight at 4px with capitalised labels — the gap between those radii is deliberate.
Geometric blue chevrons, rectangles cut at 45 degrees, frame the hero photography and echo the wordmark.
